ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living)? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living).
   D. Say Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah? (1 mark)

   B. Use Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

4. Which response best shows understanding of Taraweeh and Witr? (1 mark)

   C. Use Hadith on Knowledge to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Knowledge.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

   B. Spreading rumours

12. Which response best shows understanding of Miracles of Prophets? (1 mark)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
